assessment_scope: offline retained-export measurement and three-issuer source trace; no provider calls, re-acquisition, extraction, order logic, or strategy-score computation
interpretation_limits: The assessed SEC-fundamentals export is a distinct generation from the acquisition cache used by the prior material-only packet; no claim is made that this alternate generation was consumed by that packet.

The current fundamentals_provenance.json hash differs from fundamentals_publication.json; removing only the net_income_concept_priority field reconstructs the marker-bound hash, but this byte reconstruction does not establish when or why that field was added or bind the alternate export atomically to the acquisition generation.
The aggregate exporter omits country, currency/unit, and source-origin columns; audit concepts and three bounded archive traces cannot establish universe-wide foreign or unit reconciliation.
Rows with more than one public-date vintage are revision candidates, not confirmed amendments solely from row multiplicity.
Q4 concept-consistent symbol-year candidates are not derived values and do not prove source-unit, currency, or accounting-basis reconciliation.
Snapshot coverage is reported for the two named member dates and the retained S&P membership seed only; it is not full V5 three-universe coverage or a benchmark score evaluation.

q4_evidence_in_retained_audit.limitation: candidate count uses audit fiscal-period/concept metadata; source units, currency, and accounting-basis reconciliation are not proved by this audit summary

bounded_archive_sample.foreign_coverage_limit: This deterministic US issuer sample does not measure foreign issuers. The exporter/master has no country column; form counts are evidence only for the sampled CIKs.
bounded_archive_sample.scope: For each of A, AMZN, and MSFT, opened only its single CIK JSON member in each already hash-verified ZIP. No archive-wide extraction or other archive member reads were performed.

revision_vintage_candidates.interpretation: retained public-date versions; audit can trace filings, but row multiplicity alone is not labeled a confirmed amendment

publication_timing.rule: public_date is already the first supplied SPY session strictly after the acceptance calendar date, with filed-date fallback only; snapshot code does not shift it again

roe_input_availability.definition: availability only; latest nonmissing annual net income and latest nonmissing balance-sheet equity by period_end, as visible at the snapshot; no ROE score is calculated

runtime.timezone: UTC timestamps in source fields are parsed as UTC; membership dates remain calendar dates

archive_digest_reuse.same_path_and_same_size_assumption: The current archive bytes are assumed unchanged because source_directory, byte size, prior actual/expected SHA-256, current provenance hash, and archive-sidecar hashes agree. The selected ZIP members are read again for the corrected trace.

source_identity.public_date_rule: first supplied SPY trading day strictly after SEC acceptance calendar date; filed date fallback only

marker_bound_provenance_reconstruction.interpretation: byte reconstruction only; it does not establish when, by whom, or why the current provenance field was added
